mutations.desc: spread treats bid = 0 as valid
spread_bps divides by ask instead of midpoint
locked quote gives spread 0 available
crossed quote returns an absolute-value spread
locked gate also withholds signing (request 1 option B)
inside-spread price split at midpoint instead of unclassified
epsilon comparison exclusive at the boundary
quote age 3 s treated as stale (exclusive limit)
quote age limit off by one ns (3 s + 1 ns passes)
window_end ignored, last-print anchor always used
window excludes a print exactly at window_end
window includes a print after window_end
window start boundary exclusive
share denominator is referenced premium only
short share also requires spot (joint coupling)
OTM share also requires expiry
joint output needs only one of civil date and spot
short-dated limit off by one day (dte <= 3)
coverage counts excluded-condition updates
coverage window excludes update at exactly -300 s
coverage minimum is 6 instead of 5
unclassified premium added to ask side
signing accepts bid = 0
ask-side label reads 'bullish-side proxy'
share threshold exclusive (> instead of >=)
window_end hard-coded to T instead of the request value
OTM test inclusive at the money
joint short amount needs expiry only
double touch (locked or wide epsilon) resolved as ask
stale checked before validity gates
quote at the same ns as the trade is unusable
quote after the trade is usable
coverage gate also blocks nothing (blocks list empty)
